metadata.case_name: KO KAM WAI v. SZE HAK FUNG T/A CHUNG FUNG CO AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: master interior decoration worker (specialised in internal partition and false ceiling work)

source: He suffered contusion injuries to his back and left knee in the accident.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of lower back or pelvis

source: A MRI done in April 2003 showed left knee medial meniscal injury as well as a haemangioma over the lumbar region of his back which was not related to his injury.
He suffered contusion injuries to his back and left knee in the accident.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the knee or lower leg

manifestations.description: pain in his left knee, which affected his sleep
could only walk or stand for about 30 minutes
difficulty in climbing stairs and in squatting down
had to take painkillers and he had consequential stomach-ache
could not lift heavy objects; his left leg was weak
there was pain at his back
his sexual life had been affected
he could not enjoy sports that he used to enjoy prior to the accident
limping gait and some residual pain and disability in his knee
no neurological deficit at the back

treatments_future: arthroscopic partial meniscectomy of the medial meniscus

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Could not enjoy sports that he used to enjoy prior to the accident.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
